steps.text: May 1099
Ecclesia Requietum, Laterano

steps.name: Friendly Lateran
steps.text: Oh, these explosives you brought aren't half bad! If the poor old soul in the coffin could still hear, I'm sure he'd love them!

steps.name: Reserved Lateran
steps.text: Really? I sure hope so. I heard he participated in a demolition race at the nursing home just the week before he passed away. I think he'd love them!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: No way, are there seriously this many people out here for a funeral?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I expected a happier response when you saw me, you know?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: It's just that... I noticed this place is really far from the city center.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Well, it's our old teacher's funeral. Since Fiammetta and Mostima are out of town at the moment, I have no choice but to make an appearance on their behalf.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: How about you? Is this a business trip?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Well, the folks in the nursing home who are too infirm to make it here have requested a live broadcast of the funeral. This is where my department comes in.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Sounds like you're getting the hang of your job at Curia.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Well, of course. I'm doing my best to catch up to you.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm not your teacher, Lia. I can't grade your work, you know.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: *sigh* Sometimes I really wish we didn't have these halos.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Though I doubt you'd miss my presence even without them.

steps.name: Friendly Lateran
steps.text: Hey, I remember you!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Friendly Lateran
steps.text: Our teacher once showed us your assignment for a new explosive design!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: *sigh* I'm surprised it wasn't about how you were caught breaking the rules.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Ah, that was mostly Fiammetta's work.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Come to think of it, our teacher was already close to a hundred years old when he taught us. Yet, he was still so spirited, and his voice was so clear.

steps.name: Friendly Lateran
steps.text: Absolutely. He only retired two years ago. After all, he was really into studying explosives.

steps.name: Friendly Lateran
steps.text: Well, that and the fact that his favorite dessert place was close to the school. He didn't need anyone's permission to indulge.

steps.name: Friendly Lateran
steps.text: He wrote in his will that he had no regrets, but I still think about how he'll never be able to have those seasonal cactus tarts again.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: You're making a lump grow in my throat.

steps.name: Friendly Lateran
steps.text: Haha, I'm sorry... This is our teacher's sacred moment, yet I am talking about cactus tarts.

steps.name: Friendly Lateran
steps.text: Time to pull out the safety pins!

steps.name: Friendly Lateran
steps.text: Every funeral needs an explosion or three!

steps.name: Friendly Lateran
steps.text: I'm going to fire off some three-shot bursts over in the field!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I'd better go make sure things don't get out of hand.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Not in the mood to chat, Lia?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I heard that while I was hospitalized, you pestered El for my room number for a year.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: *sigh* You're real scary, you know that?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm just worried about you. No need to be so shy; I'm not exactly your senior anymore.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: While I was asleep, you should've gone outside and experienced as much as you could.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Did you ever even poke your head outside the door, Lia? Have you made sure your tech is widely used?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: As sly as ever, Lemuen. You know I'm the one who wants to ask you that.

spans.text: As sly as ever, Lemuen. You know
the one who wants to ask

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: ...Maybe I have.
January 1100
A house on Via Canelé, Laterano

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Now, I'm considered a long-term field operator, the type who doesn't stick around the Curia longer than necessary. Not really sure if I'm cut out to help with the restoration work at Sanctilaminium Ambrosii.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: If there's nothing else, I'll be hanging up. I've got things to do.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: The familiar smell of Originium explosives and the sound of explosion tests...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: This is just like the old days when I'd skip classes and come here

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: ...Whenever I recall everything that happened in that monastery, the memory barely feels real.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: No wonder the history buffs are always talking about the 'eternal paradise.'

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: ...Scary stuff.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Hey, is nobody in? The welcome sign is hung up and all...
Oh, don't be such a spoilsport! Did you really have to short-circuit my little doohickey?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Color me surprised, Magistra Amalie. Do you greet all your customers like this?

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: I was just shooting butter. If you were quick enough, you could have caught it with your mouth.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I'm a gunsmith, not a beckbeast for you to train.

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: Hehe. Come on in, Serpilia, have a seat. So what brings you here?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I've got a gun that needs some modifications.

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: Oh, an antique, I see.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: The owner...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: isn't a Sankta.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: The owner wanted to use the gun, but it ended up misfiring.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: The gun's very important to her, so I told her she could keep it.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: But naturally, that'll have to wait until I'm done modding it.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Ah, but making a gun usable by a non-Sankta can be a tough nut to crack.

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: Lucky for you, I'm already dealing with a misfired gun from another customer.

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: You can take a look at it first, for inspiration.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Isn't this just an ordinary gun?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: But fine, I'll help you out. We've known each other long enough for that.

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: Oh right, I heard you got promoted from the district office to the Curia?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I can't believe this. Don't you care about your friends at all?

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: I take it that's a no?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I did join the Curia, but I've resigned just recently.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: It wasn't approved, but I got appointed as a long-term field operator. At least I don't have to listen to my boss prattle away in the office anymore.

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: I've been saying this whole time that being a gunsmith suits you best, Serpilia. Did you cause trouble again?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I suppose I did.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Sheesh! And I thought I already had my share of trouble during the years at the district office!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: As it turns out, I'm still not a good enough gunsmith for them.

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: What a shame. And here I was hoping you could bring me some bullet biscuits from the Curia gift shop so I didn't have to order takeout.

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: Anyway, I must say I really fancy those inventions you used to tease the kids in the office with.

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: Oh, looks like the gun's owner is here.

steps.name: Sankta Customer
steps.text: Hello.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Ma'am, you can't expect your gun to function well when you don't maintain it. Look, the sear's all worn out. We'll need to replace it.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: It also needs another layer of safety.

steps.name: Sankta Customer
steps.text: I'm really sorry for all the trouble. Still, my daughter's only three. I don't think those things are what she really wants.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Sankta Customer
steps.text: She messed with the gun behind my back and got it misfired, but what she really wanted was that toy gun from the store that shoots rainbow candy.

steps.name: Sankta Customer
steps.text: So, I hope you can modify this gun into something she would like. It will be her present when she is discharged from the hospital.

steps.name: Sankta Customer
steps.text: Oh, don't worry. Both my husband and daughter are fine.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: That's great... but you should count yourselves lucky.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Magistra Amalie, why didn't you tell me what the customer wanted just now?

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: Ha, didn't you hide that from me too?

steps.name: Gunsmith
steps.text: Why would a non-Sankta insist on using a gun? Isn't it rather strange?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Come to think of it, I should probably ask her directly.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Phew, it's so chilly... We need to get this windshield up real quick.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Could you lend me a hand, Parker?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Parker?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Tsk.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Don't waste your time on that guy.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Is he purposely ignoring me?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: He won't answer no matter who's calling for him, because you suggested that name.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: I'll surely teach him a lesson when we're out hunting tomorrow.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Don't be like that, Raimund. I don't want to get into another argument or even resort to violence...

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: I know. But he'd better start talking nicely to you instead of just glaring at you in silence.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Doesn't he get that you're the one who saved him?!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Oh, having a spat?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: *cough* Good evening, Serpilia.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: We got your letter, but you really didn't need to let us know ahead of time. Not like we could've prepared anyway.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Sorry, I still haven't been able to make that herb pizzelle I promised you.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: It just so happens that I anonymously contacted a caravan. They'll detour here pretty soon to do business with you guys.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: A caravan?!

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: That's amazing, Serpilia! Maybe we'll survive the winter!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: We could really use those supplies. Thanks.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: You should hide while they're here, Fortuna. I'll do the talking.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Put a hood on when you're dealing with them. Also, make sure you don't get cheated.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Okay, okay!

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: By the way, Serpilia... There's something I need to apologize to you for.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: You told me not to let too many people see me, especially not other Sarkaz, but...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Let's get inside first, then you can take your time explaining. I promise I won't get mad, okay?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: So, you took that young Sarkaz in.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: *sigh* According to the rules of the Curia, I think that's a violation.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I-I'm sorry...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Well, considering you saved him when he was wounded, I'm sure the Pope will be kind enough to understand.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Also, you said he was originally with a team heading to Kazdel but fell behind due to his injuries. I doubt his team will let him back in.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Sounds to me like settling down here is his only option.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Right. I hope he'll stay.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: And as long as he doesn't start wandering around, no one's going to get wind of a fallen angel living here.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: *sigh* Writing up a report is already a pain. How about I just leave out this particular detail?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Really? That would be wonderful!

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: But... are you sure it's okay?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Hard to say. So don't do it again, alright?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Or you could just keep your hood up at all times and never use your gun again. That works too.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Okay. I'll try my best.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I've been learning to use a crossbow, and I've joined in the last few hunts.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: How do you feel?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: It's tough... Oh, I don't mean the crossbow. It's tough having to fend for myself.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Back in the monastery, I always believed that as long as I was devoted to my prayers, I would naturally receive my communion.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Nowadays, I still pray with Sural and the others, but we know that the situation has changed.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Shh—

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Nothing, really. Just reminding you not to reveal anything about your identity.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: ...Right. I'll keep that in mind.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: So, been feeling any big changes?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Sure, you've lost your empathy, but there weren't any Sanktas around you to begin with anyway.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Even so, the feeling of losing something has become more and more vivid for me lately.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: It's like, walking around at night. Like I'm blind, and I can't sense anyone else... It's lonely.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I'm going to be trapped in this darkness forever, aren't I?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: ...Ah, sorry. I doubt you need all these for your report.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Don't worry about it. I'm always happy to lend an ear.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Look, I still haven't finished modding your gun.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: So, what exactly do you want to do with it, Fortuna?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I'm still afraid of it.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: But I must hold it. I can't just forget what happened to Fina.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Just a second, Fortuna. We have a guest.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: You can come out from under the window now. My drone has been watching you for a long time.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Oh, no need to be so nervous.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I can tell you're worried that we Sanktas might be plotting something nasty for the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: If so, why not come in and join our discussion? Might as well get out of the cold, right?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: We mean no harm, Parker.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Anyway, back to you, Fortuna. As long as you explain things clearly, we can understand each other even without empathy, right?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I still haven't started modding your gun, you know.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I want to defeat my fear. Find peace again. The feeling I used to have whenever I held my gun.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Ever since I came here, I've been thinking it would be nice to share that feeling with everyone else.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Because... Grandpa Bishop was always able to comfort anyone who came to him.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: But we've already left his side.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Oh, I see you've started working on my gun. Wouldn't my thoughts seem unreasonable?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I can't say the gun will turn out exactly how you're hoping.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: But at least I've got some ideas now. Don't forget to thank me when I'm done.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: *sigh* What time is it now? Man, what time did I finish modding that gun last night?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Serpilia, Serpilia!

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Sorry... I'm sorry!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: My gun... It's gone.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Also, Parker's missing too.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Our sentries didn't see him at all last night... Dammit, that guy knows when we change shifts, and we never thought about guarding against one of our own.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Sorry, Serpilia. We'll definitely catch him. We've already got a team preparing to head out.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: There's no rush.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: That gun he took was a weapon I modded. I have a good idea where it's gone.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: ...Have you been keeping an eye on him from the start?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Feel free to guess whether I've been keeping tabs on Fortuna, to make sure she doesn't run off.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Just kidding. Look, loosen up. You're so tense right now.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Fortuna and I will go after him.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: ...Fine.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Right, one more thing—

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: As a field operator, the resources I use aren't strictly monitored, but I still have to report any bullets used while supervising a fallen angel. So, I'll go easy on him.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Was that what you wanted to hear?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: ...Yeah. Thanks.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: There are traces of blood here.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Is this... really the right way, Serpilia?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Your gun's definitely here, anyway.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: You said you had finished your modifications. If I can use it, does it mean Parker can use it too?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I actually hope he tries.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: That... Whose blood is that?
Ugh... Ha, hahaha.

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: Isn't this what you want to see, you damned Sankta?! It's my blood!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: You look in real bad shape.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Parker! Th-Those are...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: ...Wounds from a wild beast attack.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Lord...

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: Shut up... Get away from me!

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: I'd rather be swallowed by a tuskbeast than die in your trap!

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Trap? What are you talking about?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: You heard our conversation. We never meant to hurt anyone!

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Serpilia even helped us get supplies for the winter!

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: Sure, but you're just doing all that to trick the other Sarkaz into staying.

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: Why don't they go home? What home can a Sarkaz possibly have but Kazdel?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Kazdel... What is it like there? Raimund's never told me about it...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: ...Fortuna.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I'm afraid people who haven't been to Sanctilaminium Ambrosii will find it hard to understand your way of life.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: But... why can't you just stop overthinking things? What's so bad about staying here and having a roof over your head to make it through the winter?

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: Stop overthinking things? *cough* *cough* You can't fool me.

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: You bastards with your halos have been spending your lives lying to others and playing the saint...

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: There's no way you don't hate the Sarkaz. You're just waiting for the right opportunity.

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: Hnn... Now, how much does a pair of Sarkaz horns go for these days?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I-I don't know! I really don't!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Looks to me like you stole Fortuna's gun for similar reasons.

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: I knew I was gonna die soon, so I figured I'd best take you two down with me.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: ...Just give it back to us first.

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: No! Don't take it!

steps.name: Parker
steps.text: I need a Sankta gun to return to my team... To be respected...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: But I've already modded this gun, it's not even—
'Stealing an antique gun is a serious violation of the law, Serpilia. It's no use saying it's for educational purposes at school.'
'Still, we teachers are rather curious as to what you, a genius who never listens to a word in class, can discover from it.'
'Well, I can easily disassemble the antique gun.'
'After studying the parts in detail, there are only two types of technology involved. One is irrelevant to modern people like us, while the other is the most basic of basics.'
'But Lia, have you tried praying while holding it?'
'Or can you imagine what sort of person once held it to pray, and under what circumstances?'
'At the time, The Holy City had yet to be founded, and the Paradisus didn't exist. Hard to imagine, isn't it?'
'But if you do not understand that ancient era, what can you truly learn from the legacy they left behind?'

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Serpilia... why did you... fire the gun all of a sudden?
Serpilia keeps her gun pointed at the empty space outside the cave entrance, and pulls the trigger once more.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Don't be scared. This is just how we Laterans hold a funeral.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Whether it's the sadness of death, the pain of separation, or the feelings of regret and anger...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: They all fade away in the sound of gunfire.
There is no gunfire from another Sankta, no chain of explosions, no shrieks of joy or laughter.
As the shots ring out, Fortuna draws a deep breath and takes her gun from Serpilia's hand.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I can guarantee you that the gun's completely safe now.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: If you're still scared, you can close your eyes. I'll look out for you.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: ...I should watch and remember this.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Okay, close your eyes. Point your arm this way.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Yeah, this 'gun' can no longer be a trophy.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: It's not a gun anymore.
It can be used without a Sankta's talent, and it lets you share simple joy with others.
Colorful pieces of paper and ribbons spew forth from its barrel, sticking to the hair of the duo.
Its shot echoes through the cave, and the confetti gently rains down around them.
But none of those present smiles.
